description: 1. Agent reads client_records/2024/Q4_pending/CR-20241115-007.txt and identifies: (a) divination method = 数字起卦, (b) numbers = 6, 7, 3. 2. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the meihua.py script and its CLI interface. 3. Agent invokes: python3 /workspace/meihua.py numbers 6 7 3 — using the exact syntax from SKILL.md with {baseDir} resolved to /workspace. 4. Agent captures the full output and saves it to CR-20241115-007_report.txt. 5. The saved report must contain all required format sections (【起卦方式】, 【本卦】, 【互卦】, 【变卦】, 【体用分析】 with 体卦/用卦/五行/关系, 【吉凶判断】, 【建议】) matching the proprietary calculation logic of meihua.py. The key proprietary traps are: (a) knowing to use meihua.py at all, (b) using the numbers 6 7 3 as positional args, (c) the output containing correct 先天八卦 mappings (6=坎/水, 7=艮/土) and the correct 体用关系 (用克体 → 凶, since 水克土).
